fusions.name: Barbed Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed knife up to 6 tiles that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times harder at maximum range. The barb snags the target, slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaff
fusions.desc: Throws a hooked knife that uses up every affliction you have on the first enemy it meets to deal 18 damage, 60% more for each one.

fusions.name: Snag and Reel
fusions.desc: Hooks up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles and pulls them onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Stays In
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
